courseOutcomes.description: Understand Laplace transform and its properties to solve differential equations.
Apply inverse Laplace transforms and convolution theorem to system response analysis.
Express periodic functions as Fourier series and compute half-range expansions.
Analyze finite-dimensional vector spaces, bases, inner products, and Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization.
Evaluate linear transformations, kernel, range, and rank-nullity relationships.
Compute eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and diagonalize symmetric and square matrices.

courseOutcomes.description: Analyze diode wave-shaping circuits, clippers, and clampers.
Design rectifier circuits with capacitive, inductive, and filter networks.
Examine BJT small-signal models and design single-stage amplifiers.
Model MOSFET amplifier topologies and analyze AC small-signal parameters.
Evaluate power amplifier classes (Class A, B, AB, C) and efficiency.
Understand operational characteristics of power electronic devices (Thyristors, IGBTs, GTOs).

Design MOSFET differential amplifiers and evaluate CMRR and input impedance.

Design sinusoidal oscillators (RC phase shift, Wien bridge, Crystal) and waveform generators.
